evidence.quote: SATELLITE must provide images for a fluid lensing tool to analyse reefs

criteria.reasoning: Logical structure with headings and executive summary, but figure labelling inconsistent, no formal figure numbers/titles, some tables duplicated, Wikipedia used as source despite prohibition, references not properly formatted.

technical_issues.issue: RAAN set to 27.33° as initial launch facility location – incorrect, RAAN is inertial longitude, not latitude, and will not start at Kourou longitude. Correct SSO RAAN set by LTAN.
Argument of Latitude used to replace AOP/ν for e=0 is valid, but reported as 0° static; should vary with time - minor interpretation issue.
Vega E first flight claimed 2024 – schedule optimistic, but selection rationale of SSMS rideshare to SSO LEO is appropriate.

overall: Solid preliminary SSO mission for GBR monitoring with good STK support and trade discussion, meeting all space segment sections; presentation and referencing weaknesses and minor orbital mechanics slips prevent higher mark.
